info.title: Admin API
info.description:
# Admin API

GraphQL + REST for the Tomago **dashboard** (like Medusa **Admin API**).

## Base URLs

| Environment | URL |
|-------------|-----|
| Staging | `https://tomago-staging-7125900076.europe-west3.run.app` |
| Production | `https://tomago-649000455905.europe-west3.run.app` |

## Auth

1. Login → 2. Get Firebase Token → 3. GraphQL

Requires admin/owner account with dashboard roles.

## Seed user

`admin@tomoga.demo` / `TomogaAdmin123!` (after seed with auth)

post.description:
Email/password login. Returns JWT + `authenticationUid`.

**Next:** Get Firebase Token, then GraphQL.
Mint Firebase ID token from `authenticationUid`. Required for GraphQL.
Multipart field `files` (max 30). Auth: Firebase ID token.

Requires Firebase ID token (Admin).
